g.text: B Benefit under each noise model
64 development cases | same angles | 1,024 samples | 128 noise trajectories/circuit; simulated IBM Fez calibration
A: fixed-cohort Monte Carlo intervals. B: paired group + Monte Carlo intervals (95%, pointwise).
Gate channels include gate-duration relaxation; idle means scheduled delays. Noise effects need not add. No QPU execution.
